decisions.reason: As a web-map add-on built on the core offer and publicly launched with its own page and rapid releases, it carries sunk development and reputational commitment that make management more likely to retain it unless it is clearly obsolete.

Its prominent mobile-usability positioning on the home page ties it to the firm's geospatial integration direction, so management is inclined to continue supporting it rather than admit a misstep after several years.
Because this GIS platform is a flagship product line closely linked to the firm's stated strategic direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.

This field-data-capture software remains close to the established enterprise geospatial portfolio and reflects substantial invested effort, which encourages continued backing despite any mixed commercial traction.

Although a search extension is easier to prune than a flagship platform, it still sits inside the firm's core web-map domain and prior investment and portfolio breadth push management toward keeping it for now.
